ibuprofen.lisinopril: Decreases blood pressure medication effectiveness and increases strain on kidneys.
ibuprofen.aspirin: Increases risk of severe gastrointestinal bleeding.

warfarin.aspirin: Severe bleeding risk. Both medications prevent blood clotting.
warfarin.acetaminophen: High doses can abnormally increase the effects of Warfarin.

clarithromycin.atorvastatin: Can increase statin levels in the blood, leading to muscle toxicity.
